verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an error-monitoring SaaS, but nothing in the evidence documents selecting many errors and acting on them at once, whether in the dashboard or through a bulk API endpoint. The nearest items don't qualify. Status actions and keyboard shortcuts are described per error. Automatic assignment rules are rule-based triage automation, a different capability. The Data Access API is a developer building block, and retroactive data redaction is an adjacent compliance feature.
